label: exploratory
exp_id: EXP-001..EXP-004 (pilot of the planned arms; development seeds only)
kind: pre-freeze pilot at full draft run length
purpose: Measure runtime per run, projected full-matrix time, seed-to-seed spread of the primary metric and degenerate cells, for the owner's freeze decision. Not evidence for any hypothesis; effect estimates are not to be quoted.
commands: uv run python -m market.cli run --config experiments/configs/pilot-mixtures.json --workers 8
uv run python -m market.cli run --config experiments/configs/pilot-liquidity.json --workers 8
uv run python -m market.cli run --config experiments/configs/pilot-shock.json --workers 8
config: experiments/configs/pilot-*.json; T = 100,000, B = 10,000, dt = 50, draft v0.1 values

outputs.runtime_per_run_s_uncontended_serial: 0.64 to 0.68 (4 arms, seed 1, engine check before commit d39bccd; same engine code)
outputs.projected_full_matrix_480_runs: about 2.3 min wall on 8 workers at the loaded rate (480 / 140 x 39.4 s); about 5 to 18 CPU-minutes in total; far below the 2-hour planning budget
outputs.planning_consequence: with paired SD 0.051, 30 seeds detect d_z 0.53, about 0.027 VCI units (approximate CI half-width 0.019); 100 seeds detect d_z 0.28, about 0.015

degenerate.low-ZI+TF (EXP-002 low liquidity with tr: 10 of 10 flagged: one-sided fraction 0.18 to 0.20, maximum drawdown 0.9996 (mid reached the 1-tick price floor)

artifacts: results/exploratory/PILOT-MIX/, results/exploratory/PILOT-LIQ/, results/exploratory/PILOT-SHOCK/ (runs, run_manifest.json, metrics.csv, tables, figures, summary.md, summary.pdf)
determinism_check: the batch was run twice (before and after commit 6e3ea17, which changed only the manifest dirty flag); per-arm metric SDs were identical to all printed digits
failures: First batch recorded git dirty = true because untracked result files counted as dirty; fixed in 6e3ea17 (untracked files ignored) and the batch rerun; first batch deleted.
hardware: Apple M1 Pro, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 15.3.1; shared machine, load average about 75 during the batches (other sessions running)
